scripts.db:migrate: sh -c 'if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then node dist/scripts/migrate.js; else tsx scripts/migrate.ts; fi'
scripts.db:seed: sh -c 'if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then node dist/scripts/seed.js; else tsx scripts/seed.ts; fi'
scripts.db:fresh: sh -c 'if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then node dist/scripts/fresh.js; else tsx scripts/fresh.ts; fi'
scripts.db:fresh:seed: sh -c 'if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then node dist/scripts/fresh.js --seed; else tsx scripts/fresh.ts --seed; fi'
